-- update app_user set sub = 'cc379429-c77b-4e3d-866a-3249a285cd87' where id = (select app_user_id from user_profile where first_name = 'Macon');

SELECT 
  up.id as up_id,
  up.first_name,
  up.last_name,
  au.id AS au_id,
  au.sub
FROM user_profile up 
LEFT JOIN app_user au ON au.id = up.app_user_id 
WHERE first_name = 'Macon';
